item.title: Sandra Cantu’s Killer Claimed Her Suitcase Was Stolen
item.description: Eight-year-old Sandra Cantu disappeared in Tracy, California, in 2009. A suitcase linked investigators to neighbor Melissa Huckaby, who claimed it had been stolen. Huckaby pleaded guilty to first-degree murder in 2010 and was sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: The Gerrish Family’s Plea For Help Never Went Through
item.description: Jonathan Gerrish, Ellen Chung and their one-year-old daughter died during a California hike in August 2021. Investigators recovered an unsent text asking for help after they ran out of water. Authorities determined they died from hyperthermia and probable dehydration.

item.title: Paulette Gebara Was Found In Her Bed After Nine Days
item.description: Four-year-old Paulette Gebara Farah was reported missing in Mexico in March 2010. Nine days later, investigators found her body between her mattress and bed frame. Authorities concluded she died accidentally and acknowledged failures in the initial search.
